en.sayed-ali-raza: Praise be to Allāh, Creator of people;
He has spread the earth. He makes streams to flow and vegetation to grow on high lands.
His primality has no beginning, nor has His eternity any end.
He is the First and from ever. He is the everlasting without limit.
Foreheads bow before Him and lips declare His oneness.
He determined the limits of things at the time of His creating them, keeping Himself away from any likeness.
